Replace every one of the four views with a real photograph of the real-world object this model stands for: an evil skeleton archer, a real creature of ordinary human proportions, standing upright and facing forward with the arms held out from the body, a bare white skull head with glowing red eyes and bared teeth inside a folded purple wool hood pinned by a bone clasp, dark iron spiked pauldrons on both shoulders, a dark iron breastplate, a torn red cloth banner at the waist, dark iron greaves, two separate legs in brown leather boots with iron buckles. This is not a 3D render, not a game asset, not a toy, figurine or miniature, not clay or plastic, not a painting or an illustration and not a cartoon: it is a real object photographed in the real world. Keep exactly the same design as <image1>: the same parts in the same places, the same colour scheme, the same pose, and in each of the four views the same camera angle and the same side of the object. Each photograph shows the whole object, centred, cut out on a plain flat light grey background, with no ground beneath it, no base, platform or patch of grass, no shadow on the ground, no text, no labels and no lines or frames between the four views. The hands are empty: they hold nothing at all, no weapon, shield, staff, tool or light, and keep the same pose as in <image1>.
